parts: I'd like to set up this investigation similarly to the one that we had worked on regarding the Riemann hypothesis. Can you please also populate all of the current materials in /Users/ebbaker/Documents/ChatGPT/Generalized Isothermal Coordinates, but organize it in the fashion of shifted-zeta-positivity. Any of the tools and workflows should be kept, but specific investigations, any specific work, avoid files or result summaries should not be carried over, and the documents should be tailored to this investigation. Please create a README file that briefly discusses the program, including the fact that the initial investigation was motivated by some unfinished draft papers of mine, which should be included in the references (as they currently are). Please also ask me for any clarifications about how the repo should be set up.
